text:
emma.support: FYI customer ACME reported embeddings suddenly moved to 1024 dims, downstream client asserts on shape and ingestion pipeline broke. Root call from their app: 'received embedding length 1024, expected 512'

jessica.cs: Customer says they recently rotated keys and are setting both org+project headers while testing multitenant routing. They pasted curl that reproduces it.

emma.support: Curl they sent (sanitized):
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_proj_abc\" \n  -H \"X-RW-Org: org_ACME\" \n  -H \"X-RW-Project: proj-123\" \n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \n  -d '{"model":"embedding-ada-512","input":["hello world"]}'
```

tom.eng: I pulled the gateway trace for that request id. Service selected model=embedding-bert-1024, reason=project_pin (project config pinned to legacy bert model).

ben.infra: Log snippet from router: `2026-02-18T15:12:04Z request_id=rq_9c2 selected_model=embedding-bert-1024 selection_reason=project_override headers=[Authorization, X-RW-Org, X-RW-Project]`

jessica.cs: So outcome = project header wins and pinned project mapping points at a different embedding family -> dim mismatch. Customer didn't realize project header would override org-scoped key.

tom.eng: Repro steps I used:
1) create auth token with project-scoped key (sk_proj_...)
2) issue request with both X-RW-Org and X-RW-Project
3) get embedding length 1024
This is deterministic.

oliver.sre: Impact: downstream customers with older projects pinned to larger models will see shape mismatches, increased payload size, slower throughput and potential OOMs for tight consumers. Also increases token compute cost. Need a quick mitigation.

tom.eng: Quick mitigation options:
- customer action: remove X-RW-Project header or use org-scoped key only (fastest)
- platform hotfix: change header precedence so for embeddings we prefer org over project until customers migrate (canary 10%)
- longer: console validation to warn when project pin model dimension != requested model dimension

ben.infra: I can push a gateway config flip to prefer org header for embedding requests. Will do canary 10% on edge (eng-oncall aware). ETA ~40m.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: gateway/header-precedence-canary -> 10% (hash: 0f3d2a).

jessica.cs: I'll send ACME the temporary workaround and ask them to remove the X-RW-Project header while we run the canary. Will cc legal/partners for potential billing delta.

tom.eng: Also adding a runtime validation: if selected_model.dim != client_expected_dim then emit HTTP 409 with message 'embedding dimension mismatch - model selected is {selected_model} dims={d}, expected={d_expected}'. We should only enable for a short window to avoid breaking more users; primarily emit as warning metric for first pass.

oliver.sre: Rollout plan:
- canary gateway flip (ben) 10% -> monitor 'embed_dim_mismatch' metric + p50/p95 latency for embeddings
- if stable 2h -> promote to 100%
- alert if mismatch increases or 5xx spikes :bell:

ben.infra: Canary is live. Monitoring dashboards pinned to #eng-oncall.

emma.support: Customer confirmed they can switch off X-RW-Project and ingest resumed. They asked for a short explanation they can share with infra team.

jessica.cs: Draft message for ACME: "Hey — your requests set both X-RW-Org and X-RW-Project. Project header currently takes precedence and your project was pinned to an older 1024-dim embedding model. If you remove the X-RW-Project header (or use an org-scoped token), requests will be routed to the org model and return 512-dim vectors. We're rolling a short canary to prefer org header for embeddings as a stopgap and will follow up with a console validation to avoid surprises."

tom.eng: Follow-up engineering tasks (tracked):
- [ENG-#1257] gateway: make embedding header precedence configurable + feature flag
- [ENG-#1258] runtime: optional dim-check + informative 409 response
- [ENG-#1259] ops: canary metric dashboard + alert

jessica.cs: I'll mark the ticket as escalated -> eng and ops assigned. Customer is OK with the workaround for now. :thumbsup:

oliver.sre: Postmortem notes to add later: clarify precedence docs (API auth), console warning for pinned projects, and improve changelog when projects are migrated to new model families.

emma.support: closing loop for now, will reopen if ACME sees regression. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
